messages.author: 613698d0e33d6491
messages.subject: problem with shiny environment on my computer
parts:
Dear Phil,

When I run the example in the mirtCAT function help file (i.e. the unidimensional example with math items), my web browser opens, displaying a page load error, and R crashes. Is there some configuration to do before running the function mirtCAT with shiny definition ? I have tried several web browsers, but none operates. Or is it better to use RStudio to run this kind of application.
Do you have any tip about this issue ?
Thank you by advance

Pierre

messages.author: 70d0917afd869432
messages.subject: Re: problem with shiny environment on my computer
parts:
Shiny applications require RStudio.  As a test, if you download RStudio try running:

library(mirt)
itemplot(shiny = T)

It will produce an interactive plot for you to manipulate using shiny.  However, in base R, that series of commands generates an error.

What operating system are you on?
Have you tried RStudio?

If you open a terminal window, can you try entering R and then give it the commands I wrote above? (On OS X, the shiny app launches successfully)
